name: Prominent Butt Side Profile
summary: Fuller gluteal projection visible in the rear side profile silhouette.
style_goal: Accommodate rear volume comfortably while balancing lower body profile with structured upper layers.

tops.reason: Adds upper torso substance to balance rear curve.

necklines.reason: Broadens shoulder line to balance hips.

jackets.reason: Covers or skims smoothly past hip line.

avoid: Flap pockets directly on rear glutes
Thin clingy leggings without tunic top

reasoning.overall: High-waisted stretch bottoms and A-line cuts drape smoothly without pulling.

styling_tips: High-rise denim with curved waistbands prevents gaping when seated.
Layer jackets that end below the hip to streamline rear side profile.
